title.en: Google separates Gemini history and model-training controls
title.zhHans: Google 拆分 Gemini 历史记录与模型训练控制

searchSummary.en: Google announced separate Gemini chat-history retention and generative-AI training controls, with a global rollout planned over the following weeks.
searchSummary.zhHans: Google 宣布将 Gemini 聊天记录保留与生成式 AI 训练授权拆分控制，计划在未来数周全球推出。

summary.en: Dated 2026-11-16: Google announced separate Gemini chat-history retention and generative-AI training controls, with a global rollout planned over the following weeks.
summary.zhHans: 2026-11-16，Google 宣布将 Gemini 聊天记录保留与生成式 AI 训练授权拆分控制，计划在未来数周全球推出。

narrative.en: Announcement is not global activation. Turning History off may still retain chats for around two months.
narrative.zhHans: 宣布不等于全球已生效；关闭 History 仍可能保留对话约两个月。
